summary: Evidence integrity passes; the result remains an exploratory single-seed simulation comparison with one held-out source group, so broad tracking or full-PhyGile claims are not supported.
trace_status: executor-owned reviewer-call trace pending under the review-tracing protocol

warnings.detail: One training seed, four selected train clips, four test clips from one held-out source group, 32 simulator first episodes per clip, and a test set already viewed at 500 iterations.

gt_provenance.details: External video-reconstructed, GMR-retargeted, FK-derived kinematic proxy; explicitly not measured robot ground truth and not output of the evaluated policy.

score_normalization.details: Raw physical-unit errors are computed directly from reference-policy differences; no prediction-statistic denominator is used.

result_existence.details: All expected raw/metric/CSV/summary/survival/receipt/checkpoint artifacts exist; independent recomputation and direct checkpoint hashing match every principal reported value.

dead_code.details: Receipts bind all 24 evaluations to the same called evaluator/config/environment hashes. Pre-reset capture, metric recomputation, and the separately recorded state verifier all produced claimed artifacts.

scope.details: The narrow exploratory scope is accurately disclosed and cannot establish a reliable general tracker, statistical significance, or full PhyGile reproduction.

eval_type.details: Simulator evaluation against an external reconstructed/retargeted kinematic proxy; neither measured-robot real_gt nor a reference generated by the evaluated policy.

resume_update_accounting.details: Exactly 1,500 logged PPO iterations (500..1999) and 25 direct Adam counters at 10,000->40,000, difference 30,000.

final_checkpoint_selection.details: Fixed model_1999 checkpoint after the predeclared 2,000-iteration budget; no test-score selection.

pre_reset_capture.details: Capture occurs within termination computation before reset; the terminating state is retained and environment activity is cleared after step returns.

censoring_and_survival.details: Errors are right-censored at first failure with the failure row included; survival uses a fixed 128-episode denominator and matches full-clip success at the endpoint. The report warns that differing censoring windows prevent an accuracy-improvement inference.

claims.claim: Observed fixed-protocol success/duration change from 500 to 2000 PPO iterations
30,000 additional Adam steps across 1,500 added PPO iterations
Full PhyGile reproduction or validated language-to-motion generation

action_items: Add independent training seeds, more held-out source groups, and a test set not previously examined before broad or statistical performance claims.
Keep survival/success beside censored errors and retain the proxy-reference and simulation_only labels.
Verify the public release page after packaging; external availability was not used as scientific evidence.
